weights.method: every mirror vertex pair (positions matched with x negated, within 20 µm) takes the mean of its two weight sets with the bone names mirrored, a midline vertex the mean of its own and its mirrored set; the four largest influences are kept and renormalized

shoulderWeights.method: each upper arm's blend zone (vertices whose upper-arm weight lies strictly between zero and one, none influenced by the hand or a digit) grown by 6 rings over vertices whose every influence is that upper arm, its girdle, the upper chest, the chest or the spine; inside it every free vertex's weights diffused for 40 Jacobi sweeps (uniform Laplacian, weight 1/2) with the outermost ring held; each vertex then keeps its four largest influences, renormalized, a bone split over two source slots summed first

correctives.method: each sided corrective is replaced by the left one of its mirror pair and that one's exact mirror (vertex mirrored by position with x negated within 20 um, x displacement negated, input names with left and right swapped, a TT kernel's orientation kept), a sided corrective without a partner gains its mirror, and a corrective whose inputs name no side takes the mean of its field and the field's mirror
